text: {"memo": "Apple delivered FY2024 revenue of $391\u202fbillion, up from $383\u202fbillion in FY2023, representing modest top\u2011line growth. Net income fell to $94\u202fbillion from $97\u202fbillion, pulling the net margin down to roughly 24% from about 25% a year earlier. Operating income rose to $123\u202fbillion from $114\u202fbillion, lifting the operating margin to near 32% from around 30%. Diluted EPS slipped slightly to $6.08 from $6.13. Operating cash flow improved to $118\u202fbillion from $111\u202fbillion, underscoring strong cash generation. The 2% revenue increase was supported by continued demand for iPhone and services, while operating cash flow rose to $118\u202fbillion, up from $111\u202fbillion, highlighting strong cash conversion. The company\u2019s profitability metrics show a mixed picture: revenue expansion but margin pressure on the net side, offset by better operating efficiency. Valuation remains supported by robust cash flow and a solid earnings base. View: Hold pending further margin improvement."}
